tips: Beware of DCC (Dynamic Currency Conversion) at ATMs/merchants—it's often more expensive.
Weekend and holiday rates may include extra markups.
Compare banks with low-cost FX services (e.g., Wise, Revolut) for better rates.

faq.q: Why is my card's GBP amount lower than expected?
faq.a: Your bank or the merchant may add a spread above the mid‑market rate plus fees.
Dynamic Currency Conversion converts at the point of sale/ATM using the merchant's rate, which is usually worse than your bank's.

faq.q: Do rates change during the day?
faq.a: Yes. FX rates move with the market and can vary by provider and time.

faq.q: How can I reduce conversion costs?
faq.a: Decline DCC, compare providers, and avoid weekend markups when possible.

faq.q: Is this rate the same as the Bank of England rate?
faq.a: The mid‑market rate may differ from official reference rates and provider quotes.
